input: Learn to brew my own craft beer at home

gold.taskTitle: Learn to brew craft beer at home
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to learn how to brew their own craft beer at home, from scratch.

questions.title: What beer style do you most want to brew first?
questions.description: Identify the target beer style (e.g. IPA, stout, wheat beer, lager) to focus the learning path.

questions.title: Have you ever brewed beer or anything fermented before?
questions.description: Gauge the user's existing experience level to calibrate the complexity of the plan.

questions.title: What is your budget for equipment and ingredients?
questions.description: Determine how much the user is willing to spend upfront to recommend an appropriate starter setup.

questions.title: How much physical space do you have available at home?
questions.description: Understand the brewing space constraints (e.g. apartment kitchen, garage, basement) to suggest suitable equipment scale.

questions.title: How many litres or gallons do you want to brew per batch?
questions.description: Establish the desired batch size to guide equipment and ingredient quantity recommendations.

questions.title: Do you prefer learning from books, videos, or hands-on courses?
questions.description: Identify the user's preferred learning format to recommend the most suitable resources.

questions.title: When do you want to drink your first homebrew batch?
questions.description: Capture the target deadline or timeline to structure a realistic step-by-step schedule.
